title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Leeds | News | Official Site
text:
Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Leeds | News | Official Site | Chelsea Football Club 
 Xabi Alonso has provided an update on the fitness of several members of his Chelsea squad, including Joao Pedro, Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix, Moises Caicedo, Emiliano Martinez and Jorrel Hato. He also reported the latest on longer-term absentees Reece James and Jamie Gittens. 
 The Blues are back in action this weekend following the final international break of 2026. We host Leeds United at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, hoping to return to winning ways after losing at Sunderland last time out.
 Alonso confirmed he will not be able to call upon the services of Joao Pedro , who hasn’t played since the win at Everton last month because of a thigh issue.
 ‘He’s not yet fit to train with the team,’ said Alonso.
 ‘We need to wait a bit more. He’s not going to be available for Leeds. We need to see day by day how he is feeling.’
 Alonso said Lacroix, who has a hamstring problem, is in a ‘similar situation’ to the Brazilian striker and will not be able to feature against Leeds. The manager also ruled Hato out.
 He said: ‘Jorrel has a back problem. We need to be patient because it’s going to take a while.’
 There was better news regarding Acheampong and Caicedo. Acheampong didn’t play for England Under-21s during the international break, while Caicedo came off at half-time in Ecuador’s most recent friendly.
 ‘Moises is ready to start. It was discussed after playing the first game he could save some minutes. That was good for him, and he’s fine.’
 Alonso replied with an affirmative ‘yes’ when asked if Acheampong can return to action, while he also provided an update on Martinez, who represented his country during the international break. 
 ‘He is in the squad and he is selectable,’ said Alonso.
 ‘Against Sunderland two weeks ago probably there was risk, and the plan was for him to train more with Argentina and to play one game. It went well so he’s available for tomorrow.’
Alonso’s final fitness news regarded James and Gittens, who have not played for us since September.
 ‘Reece is getting there. He’s taking a step forward, but still needs some weeks.
 ‘ Jamie Gittens is better,’ added Alonso. ‘He’s already training with the team, but we want to give him more time until he comes back in the squad.’
